title: Firstfruits and Tithes

questions.question: When you come into the land, what should you take of the first of all the fruit?
options: Put it in a basket and go to the place the Lord chooses
questions.correctAnswer: Put it in a basket and go to the place the Lord chooses
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 26:2 (ESV): "you shall take some of the first of all the fruit... and put it in a basket, and you shall go to the place..."

questions.question: What confession does the offerer make?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 26:5 (ESV): "And you shall make response... 'A wandering Aramean was my father. And he went down into Egypt...'"

questions.question: Who was the "wandering Aramean"?
questions.explanation: Refers to Jacob going down to Egypt. Deuteronomy 26:5.

questions.question: What year is the year of tithing mentioned here?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 26:12 (ESV): "When you have finished paying all the tithe of your produce in the third year, which is the year of tithing..."

questions.question: To whom is the third-year tithe given?
options: The Levite, the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow
questions.correctAnswer: The Levite, the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 26:12 (ESV): "...giving it to the Levite, the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow..."

questions.question: What has the Lord declared today about the people?
options: That you are a people for his treasured possession
questions.correctAnswer: That you are a people for his treasured possession
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 26:18 (ESV): "And the Lord has declared today that you are a people for his treasured possession..."

questions.question: What have the people declared today?
options: That the Lord is their God and they will walk in his ways
questions.correctAnswer: That the Lord is their God and they will walk in his ways
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 26:17 (ESV): "You have declared today concerning the Lord that he is your God, and that you will walk in his ways..."

questions.question: What should the priest do with the basket?
options: Set it down before the altar of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Set it down before the altar of the Lord
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 26:4 (ESV): "Then the priest shall take the basket from your hand and set it down before the altar..."

questions.question: What did the Egyptians do to the fathers?
options: Mistreated and afflicted them with hard labor
questions.correctAnswer: Mistreated and afflicted them with hard labor
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 26:6 (ESV): "And the Egyptians treated us harshly and humiliated us and laid on us hard labor."

questions.question: God brought them out with what?
options: A mighty hand and an outstretched arm
questions.correctAnswer: A mighty hand and an outstretched arm
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 26:8 (ESV): "And the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm..."

questions.question: What must the offerer say he did NOT do with the tithe?
options: Eaten of it while mourning, removed it while unclean, or offered it to the dead
questions.correctAnswer: Eaten of it while mourning, removed it while unclean, or offered it to the dead
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 26:14 (ESV): "I have not eaten of the tithe while I was mourning, or removed any of it while I was unclean, or offered any of it to the dead."

questions.question: God will set Israel high above all nations in what way?
options: In praise and in fame and in honor
questions.correctAnswer: In praise and in fame and in honor
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 26:19 (ESV): "and that he will set you in praise and in fame and in honor high above all nations..."

questions.question: What is the basket offering a sign of?
options: That I have come into the land that the Lord swore to give us
questions.correctAnswer: That I have come into the land that the Lord swore to give us
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 26:3 (ESV): "...I declare today... that I have come into the land that the Lord swore to our fathers to give us."

questions.question: The prayer asks God to look down from where?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 26:15 (ESV): "Look down from your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless your people Israel..."

questions.question: How should one obey God’s voice?
options: According to all that You have commanded me
questions.correctAnswer: According to all that You have commanded me
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 26:14 (ESV): "I have obeyed the voice of the Lord my God. I have done according to all that you have commanded me."

key_verse_text: You have declared today concerning the LORD that he is your God, and that you will walk in his ways, and keep his statutes and his commandments and his rules, and will obey his voice. (ESV)
